company_name: China Resources Medical Holdings Company Limited

equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 interim condensed balance sheet; flows modelled at 100% of the group, so NCI is deducted once here (see nci_treatment)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: forward judgment, not a trailing CAGR: revenue FY2023->FY2025 CAGR is -4.7% (10,108 -> 9,176) and H1 FY2026 was -1.0%; the 5-year revenue CAGR is the FY2022 common-control combination, not organic growth
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3-yr CAGR -11.7% vs revenue +5.1% and EPS +22.9%: FY2022 shareholders' equity (9,506) was restated down to 5,812 in FY2023 after the common-control combination, FY2022 EPS (0.21) is the post-combination trough, and FY2025 EPS (0.39) carries the RMB206m one-off. None of the trailing CAGRs is a usable forward rate; FY2022 onward is the comparable revenue base and it has been shrinking since FY2023.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series, which equals reported FCF because SBC is zero and interest income is immaterial. The 3-yr FCF CAGR of 28.6% is working-capital timing plus the FY2025 one-off (underlying FY2025 FCF ~690 gives ~20%), not operating improvement: OCF before working capital has been roughly flat at RMB1.1-1.3bn since FY2023 while revenue fell 9%.

scenario_narratives.base: The DRG/DIP reform keeps cutting revenue per visit but at a decelerating rate, and the FY2025-26 cost-ratio programme (drug and consumable spend, refined medical-insurance management) holds the underlying EBITDA margin around 14.5%, roughly midway between underlying FY2025 (12.8%) and H1 FY2026 (~15.7%). Revenue dips 1.5% in FY2026 as the Mentougou IOT contracts fall away, then grows 2-3% on aging-driven volume with no acquisitions. Owner FCF settles at RMB550-700m, the business stays net cash, and the dividend keeps rising on a flat-to-slightly-growing earnings base.
scenario_narratives.bull: The margin stabilisation seen in H1 FY2026 (hospital gross margin 18.5% vs 15.7%, segment profit +42%) compounds: EBITDA margin reaches 17% by FY2030 as specialty upgrades and the 'medical care to healthcare' derivative-health services (health management centres, corporate wellness, home care) add less insurance-dependent revenue. China Resources Group's balance sheet and the national SOE-hospital divestiture pipeline restart bolt-on consolidation, lifting growth to 3-5% from FY2027. The RMB350m Yan Hua judgment is collected (not modelled, incremental).
scenario_narratives.bear: The NHSA's August-2025 DRG/DIP interim measures and tighter medical-insurance fund oversight keep per-case reimbursement falling at the FY2025 pace for two more years; volumes also decline in the legacy mining-town hospitals in Liaoning and Anhui. The H1 FY2026 margin improvement proves a one-off reset and the underlying margin settles back at the FY2025 level of ~12%. The loss of the high-margin IOT/OT management contracts is not replaced, the leadership turnover (Chairman, CEO, CFO within 18 months) stalls the transformation, and revenue shrinks 3% a year through FY2027 before flattening.

valuation_philosophy.summary: China Resources Medical is a state-backed operator of former SOE hospitals whose economics are set by China's medical-insurance tariff. The valuation is a component owner-FCF DCF in RMB, converted to the HKD quote at 1.1726, with the FY2025 one-off Yan Hua receipt (RMB206m) and working-capital timing stripped out of the run-rate so that the margin paths start from the underlying ~12.8-15.7% EBITDA range rather than the reported 15.1%. Leases are charged as an operating cost and excluded from net debt; the 17% minority interest is deducted once at book. Risk is charged once, in the flows and a 30% bear weight, at a single 9% CNY WACC. The stock trades at roughly 0.4x attributable book and ~2.7x EV/EBITDA, so a going-concern DCF will sit well above the price in all but the bear case; the terminal value is capped at 12x FCF to avoid assuming a re-rating no HK buyer has paid for this name since 2021.
key_risks_to_valuation: DRG/DIP per-case reimbursement continues to fall faster than the cost-ratio programme can offset, pushing the EBITDA margin below the bear path's 12% floor
Terminal value is a large share of enterprise value for a 2.5%-growth business; a 1pp move in WACC moves the base value by roughly 15%
Non-controlling interests are deducted at book (RMB1.39bn, ~RMB1.10/share); capitalising their actual profit share would be ~RMB0.5bn less, so this is a conservative bias

The HK quote has traded below the DCF for years: at ~0.4x book the market is pricing SOE governance, connected-transaction and capital-allocation risk that the discount rate does not separately charge
FX: the CNY->HKD rate (1.1726) is not refreshed by refresh_price.py; a 5% move in the rate moves every HKD per-share figure 5%
Working-capital swings on medical-insurance receivables make any single year's reported FCF a poor anchor; the model uses component margins, not FY2025 FCF

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range 2.285-3.49 HKD. FX from Yahoo CNYHKD=X, dated in inputs.fx_note.
data_sources.financials: 1515.HK_Metrics.csv (FY2018-FY2025 annual, H1 FY2023-H1 FY2026 interim, RMB millions) from the annual and interim reports; H1 FY2026 interim condensed balance sheet for cash, borrowings, lease liabilities, NCI and share count; FY2025 Annual Report for ROU depreciation, lease cash, the Yan Hua enforcement payment (other income note) and the income-tax discussion.
data_sources.qualitative: 1515.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-17): business model, DRG/DIP regulatory risk, IOT contract terminations, H1 FY2026 margin commentary, management turnover, bull/bear cases.

inputs.share_count_basis: 1,264,292,000 shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim); diluted EPS equals basic EPS in FY2025 and H1 FY2026, so no dilutive instruments are outstanding. Held flat; SBC is zero so there is nothing to expense or dilute.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report cash-flow reconciliation: no share-based payment expense since FY2023 (last grant vested FY2022, RMB2.2m). Equity-award taxes nil. SBC-zero market; house and street bases coincide.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (ISO CNY); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate is HKD per CNY: 1.1726 from Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T13:08:27Z. Per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by 1.1726 to the HKD quote basis. No dual listing exists for a parity check. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate, so re-fetch the rate on any later price-only refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY: 10-year China government bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.0 for an HK-listed small-cap hospital operator, plus ~1.0pp for HK small-cap illiquidity -> cost of equity ~9.3%. Debt is ~10% of capital at ~2.5% pre-tax (fiscal-subsidised bank loans). Blended WACC rounded to 9.0%. Same WACC in all three scenarios: DRG/DIP tariff risk, SOE governance and management turnover are charged in the driver paths and the 30% bear weight, not stacked on the discount rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (B), leases as operating cost: full lease cash (FY2025 principal RMB77.3m + interest RMB7.3m = RMB84.6m, 0.92% of revenue; three-year average 0.63%) charged inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path at 0.8%. Lease liabilities (RMB160.7m at 30 Jun 2026) are EXCLUDED from net debt; total_debt is interest-bearing bank borrowings only. D&A for the cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation (FY2025 total D&A 584.9 less ROU depreciation 60.9 = 524.1, 5.71% of revenue).
inputs.nci_treatment: Non-controlling interests (RMB1,386.7m book at 30 Jun 2026; 11-21% of group profit over FY2023-25) deducted once, in the equity bridge at book value. Flows are modelled at 100% of the consolidated group. Book is the conservative choice: capitalising the NCI's FY2025 profit share (RMB60m) at the model's own WACC-less-growth would give ~RMB0.9bn.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF with the non-US adaptations (currency, leases, NCI, SBC-zero). Operating hospital company; deposits, AFFO and NAV logic do not apply. SOE parentage and DRG/DIP tariff regulation are priced as margin and growth risk in the scenarios, not as a different method. BASE YEAR: FY2025 (Dec year-end). last_fcf/reported_fcf of RMB844.4m (OCF 1,358.5 less capex 514.1) is NOT the run-rate: it includes the one-off RMB206.4m Yan Hua enforcement receipt (received in cash, in other income and therefore in reported EBITDA of 1,382) and roughly RMB150m of working-capital inflow. Underlying FY2025 EBITDA is ~RMB1,176m (12.8%) and underlying owner FCF ~RMB690m. The projection is built from component margins off base_revenue, so the one-off does not propagate; the EBITDA margin paths are ex one-off. INTEREST INCOME: net cash of RMB258m is well under 1x the FCF base, so bank interest (RMB8.6m FY2025) is left in the flows and interest_income is 0; note the kpis InterestIncome row for FY2025 (0.811) is the FVTPL-interest line, not bank interest. UPSIDE NOT IN THE MODEL: the Sept-2026 Beijing court judgment for ~RMB350m against the Yan Hua parties (collection uncertain; RMB186.7m receivable already on the balance sheet) is excluded. PRICE: HKEX regular close, not an after-hours print.

bear.rationale: DRG/DIP per-case cuts continue at the FY2025 pace for two more years with volumes also slipping in the Liaoning/Anhui company towns, the cost-ratio gains of H1 FY2026 prove a one-time reset, and the margin settles at the underlying FY2025 level of ~12%. Revenue shrinks 3% a year through FY2027 and never recovers above 1% growth. Capex is sticky at 5.7% because the hospital estate still needs maintenance.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 -1.5%: H1 was -1.0% and the Mentougou IOT contracts ended 1 July 2026, so H2 loses a further slice of the Other Business segment. FY2027 flat-to-slightly-up as per-visit tariff declines (FY2025: out-patient -6.6%, in-patient -4.9%) are offset by low-single-digit volume growth. From FY2028 revenue tracks aging-driven volume at 2-3% with no acquisitions assumed (management discloses no committed pipeline).
base.margin_rationale: EBITDA margin (post-IFRS-16, before the 0.8% lease charge, ex one-off) held flat at 14.5%: underlying FY2025 was 12.8%, FY2024 15.6%, and H1 FY2026 ran ~15.7% on the seasonally stronger half after the drug/consumable cost-ratio programme. 14.5% assumes the cost-control gains are retained but fully absorbed by continuing DRG/DIP per-case cuts rather than compounding. D&A 5.7% ex-ROU equals FY2025; capex 5.5-5.7% matches the FY2023-25 average of 5.4% and H1 FY2026 annualised 5.9%. Cash tax 25% PRC statutory (FY2025 provision 25.6% of PBT). Working capital -10% of the revenue change: medical-insurance receivables exceed payables, so growth consumes cash and the FY2026 decline releases a little.
base.terminal_rationale: Terminal growth 2.5%, below China nominal GDP, for a tariff-regulated service in demographically weak regions. Cap 12x FCF: a structurally slow, regulated operator, per the method's 12-15x guidance for slower businesses.

bull.rationale: Margin recovery to 17% by FY2030 (still below FY2018-19 EBITDA margins of 29-32%) as the cost-ratio programme and specialty upgrades outrun tariff cuts, and revenue growth of 3-5% from FY2027 as SOE-hospital consolidation resumes and derivative health scales. Capex held at 5.7% longer to fund the acquisitions and digital build-out.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% house default to 30%: the business depends on a single regulator's tariff (NHSA DRG/DIP), revenue and underlying profit have fallen for two consecutive years, the high-margin IOT segment is being dismantled, and the entire senior leadership changed within 18 months during a stated transformation. Bull cut from 35% to 20% because it needs three independent things to go right at once: a durable margin recovery against an ongoing tariff cut, a restart of SOE-hospital acquisitions that management has not announced, and the derivative-health pivot scaling from ~3% of revenue. Base at 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
